tone: Use clear, concise, neutral Latin American Spanish without country-specific slang or Iberian forms.
capitalization: Use Spanish sentence case and capitalization rules rather than English title case.
button_labels: Use short consistent infinitive or imperative actions without final periods.
ui_roles: Keep labels concise, buttons action-oriented, tooltips explanatory, and warnings or errors as natural complete sentences.
technical_terms: Use broadly understood Latin American software terminology and preserve protected products, APIs, abbreviations, and identifiers.
contextual_terminology: Resolve ambiguous terms from the feature, stable ID, surface type, and neighboring strings; avoid both literal calques and region-specific wording.
punctuation: Use standard Spanish punctuation and question marks while preserving syntax tokens and accelerators.
units: Preserve numeric meaning and use locale-appropriate decimal and unit spacing.
natural_language: Prefer idiomatic region-neutral Spanish over English word order or European-Spanish defaults.
